opportunities.title: Junior Scientist Conference Grants

amount.raw: Grants up to £200 (Scheme A), up to £500/£750 (Scheme B), up to £300 (Scheme C)

opportunities.eligibility_summary: UK-based Genetics Society junior scientist members (undergraduate, Master’s, PhD students, postdocs within six years of PhD viva) for conference attendance.
opportunities.summary: Supports attendance of Genetics Society junior scientists at conferences (Society meetings, non‑Society meetings, and virtual conferences).

opportunities.title: Training Grant
opportunities.eligibility_summary: All Genetics Society members studying or working in the UK (or attending a UK‑based course).
opportunities.summary: Provides up to £1,200 to enable members to attend short genetics‑related training courses or collaborative visits.

opportunities.title: Public Engagement Grant
opportunities.summary: Supports public engagement activities related to genetics, covering travel and material costs.

opportunities.title: One‑off Meeting Grant

amount.raw: Sponsorship levels typically between £1,000 and £2,000 (larger amounts possible with justification).

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Genetics Society members proposing a genetics‑themed meeting in the UK.
opportunities.summary: Provides sponsorship for one‑off genetics meetings not organised directly by the Society.
